Can't sign in to OneDrive - Microsoft Support

content.text:
I can’t log in for you or handle your password, but here’s how you can sign in to OneDrive:

### On the web
1. Go to **onedrive.com** or **microsoft365.com**.
2. Click **Sign in**.
3. Enter your **Microsoft email/phone/Skype** or your **work/school account**.
4. Enter your password and complete any verification.

Microsoft says you can also sign in at Microsoft365.com and choose **OneDrive** from the app launcher. ([support.microsoft.com](https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/office/open-onedrive-and-upload-files-6e90fbe7-6c87-4eba-bc1b-1b91f59936f0?utm_source=openai))

### On Windows
1. Click the **OneDrive cloud icon** in the taskbar notification area, or search **OneDrive** from Start.
2. Enter your email address and password.
3. Follow the setup prompts.

If the OneDrive icon is gray or has a line through it, Microsoft says that means you’re not signed in; select it and sign in from the **Set up OneDrive** screen. ([support.microsoft.com](https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/office/can-t-sign-in-to-onedrive-3f99e6e3-042e-49a3-897a-8b7fb0fb8477?utm_source=openai))

### If you forgot your password
Use Microsoft’s account recovery/sign-in help from the sign-in page by choosing **Forgot password?** or **Can’t access your account?**

If you tell me whether you’re on **Windows, Mac, iPhone, Android, or web browser**, I can give exact steps for your device.
